title: Leak: psionic assets drugged and chipped, many die

tellings.quote: After several years of this experimentation and drug use, a lot of these people die or slip into a coma.

plain: People with supposed psychic gifts, called psionic assets, were drugged and fitted with implanted chips by a secret program, and after several years of this many of them died or fell into a coma, according to a leak from 2023. Michels tells it himself, crediting an anonymous online poster who goes by "Joey is not my name" along with Michael Herrera, a former Marine, and Jake Barber, a former helicopter pilot, both of whom make claims about secret UFO programs. If true, it would mean the government was using people up in experiments on the mind.
